subject.title: fix(logging): keep JSON console output structured across CLI routes

question: Should this logging repair establish machineOutput as a supported root plugin CLI metadata contract and use it to change diagnostic routing for existing machine-readable commands?
rationale: The reported logging bug has a clear repair direction, but the branch intentionally expands beyond that repair into a documented plugin API and observable stdout/stderr behavior across several command families; repository policy treats that as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Accept the CLI metadata contract
options.body: Approve machineOutput as the supported root-descriptor seam, with its stdout-routing behavior treated as an explicit plugin compatibility contract.

options.title: Narrow the logging repair
options.body: Keep the shared JSON diagnostic formatter and startup capture fix, then defer broader plugin command classification to a separately scoped API proposal.

options.title: Pause for owner design
options.body: Hold the branch until CLI and plugin owners choose a stable public contract for machine-readable command output.

recommendation.title: Accept the CLI metadata contract
recommendation.body: Approve machineOutput as the supported root-descriptor seam, with its stdout-routing behavior treated as an explicit plugin compatibility contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch integrates the CLI and plugin metadata behavior and is best positioned to clarify whether this API is intended as the durable supported seam.
